title: PRESERVATION OF LANGUAGE UNDERSTANDING CAPABILITIES IN SPEECH-AWARE LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the fairness of speech-aware models by comparing performance and consistency across audio prompts synthesized with male and female voices.
Measuring the fairness of speech-aware models by comparing performance and consistency across audio prompts synthesized with voices representing seven different age ranges.

Measuring the fairness of speech-aware models by comparing performance and consistency across audio prompts synthesized with voices representing different regional accents (e.g., Australian, English, Scottish).
